description: Official Bloxchain deployments, per network. This is the source of truth an integrator reads; it ships with @bloxchain/contracts and is mirrored in the public documentation. It is NOT the same file as deployed-addresses.json, which is written by the deployment scripts for whatever network they were pointed at (including local and lab chains), is git-ignored, and is never published.

declarationPolicy.whoDeclares: A network appears here only after a human release owner declares its deployment official; the release checklist records the declaration.
declarationPolicy.whatQualifies: Deployed from a tagged release, verified on the network's explorer, and intended for outside integrators. Local, lab and throwaway deployments never qualify.
declarationPolicy.howToAdd: Deploy, verify, then run: node scripts/promote-official-addresses.cjs --network <name> --chain-id <id> --declare. The script copies addresses out of deployed-addresses.json and refuses to write without --declare. Validate with: npm run validate:official-addresses
declarationPolicy.pendingRows: A contract that is not yet deployed on an official network is listed with "address": null and "status": "pending-declaration". Addresses are never guessed.

sepolia.notes: Alpha testnet. These are the contracts the Bloxchain Platform uses by default. Verify on the explorer before relying on them.

EngineBlox.notes: State machine library. Linked into AccountBlox at compile time; an account does not call it by address.

SecureOwnableDefinitions.notes: Passed as definitionAddress to the SDK's updateRecovery / updateTimeLock execution-parameter helpers.

RuntimeRBACDefinitions.notes: Passed as definitionAddress to roleConfigBatchExecutionParams and getRoleConfigActionSpecs.

GuardControllerDefinitions.notes: Passed as definitionAddress to guardConfigBatchExecutionParams and getGuardConfigActionSpecs.

AccountBlox.notes: Clone source for the official factory. Already initialized so the implementation cannot be claimed; Clones.clone copies runtime code, not storage, so an initialized template is a valid source. Do not operate this address as an account.

gas.notes: Observed gasUsed for cloneBlox against the AccountBlox template. Public networks cap a single transaction at 2^24 = 16,777,216 (EIP-7825), so send cloneBlox with an explicit gas limit at the cap and never with a bare estimate: an estimate that returns the cap looks like a real number.

CopyBlox.notes: Sanctioned public provisioning path: cloneBlox deploys and initializes an account in one transaction. This deployment predates the owner-indexed clone list, so supports.clonesOf is false and an owner's accounts must be enumerated from BloxCloned logs. The SDK factory wrapper does this automatically.
